steps.heading: Is the factory alive
steps.text: Running, queued, stuck, parked, halted — counted over the whole tree, not just what's on screen. A non-zero stuck or parked badge is one click from its cause.

steps.heading: The hierarchical tree
steps.text: Strategic roots branch into tactical work and subtasks; jobs are the leaves a worker actually claims. Drag a row to reparent it, or drop it on the bar above the tree to promote it to a root.

steps.heading: Doable next
steps.text: What the planner would pick up right now, in its own words — the same read a worker gets when it comes looking for something to do.
